claims.exact_statement: For all integers t>=6 and 0<=m<=2^t-2t, and all Boolean g:F_2^(m+t)->{+1,-1}, put f(z,x)=g(z,A_t x), where A_t has all nonzero t-bit vectors as columns. If at least half of the fibers g(z,.) are nonconstant and Var_z(E_u g(z,u)) <= (1/4) E_z Var_u(g(z,u)), then the complete physical Fourier supports have a fixed distribution-independent prefix-free code of expected length L(f)<(8/3)I(f), hence H(f)<(8/3)I(f).
hypotheses: all nonzero binary t-vectors are columns of A_t
at least half of g(z,.) fibers are nonconstant
eta^2=Var_z E_u g(z,u) <= q/4, q=E_z Var_u g(z,u)
proof_dependencies: finite-cube Fourier transfer under full-rank linear map
Kraft-McMillan inequality on complete physical support labels
